messages:
Marta (AE): Hey team — need quick deal desk decision. AcmeHealth wants a private deploy POC then convert to dedicated. They asked for 45% off list for a 6‑month pilot to get procurement signoff.

Marta (AE): POC config: 4x A100-equivalent reserved nodes, 8M tokens/day peak, private networking + KMS. List = $24,000/mo, onboarding $25k one-time. They said 45% is what procurement will approve.

Frank (Deal Desk): 45% is pretty steep for reserved infra. Do we have margin calc? Also need to know conversion probability and target term if they go prod.

Marta (AE): conversion is high — they already committed to a security review and have budget for Dedicated if pilot shows latency >= 200ms p95 and accuracy meets evaluation. Sales estimate 60% conversion.

Frank (Deal Desk): OK show me quick math.

Frank (Deal Desk): ```List monthly: $24,000
45% off -> $13,200/mo
30% off -> $16,800/mo
Onboarding: $25,000 one-time
If 6mo pilot w/ 60% conversion to 12mo commit, need to model churn but simple ARR impact looks thin at 45%
```

Raj (Solutions Eng): Technical flag — private deploy + KMS + SOC data access will increase ops cost for any on-prem-style networking. We should add a modest support surcharge if we need a dedicated network path and audit logging. Suggest $3k/mo extra during POC for runbook + 24/7 oncall.

Olivia (CISO): Security note: AcmeHealth requires SOC2 evidence and a penetration test window. We can provide SOC2 report (redacted) but timeline is ~2 weeks to assemble artifacts. Pen test needs scoping — we should avoid full private deploy before corp security sign-off. Consider limiting POC to anonymized data or synthetic dataset.

Sam (Legal): If we grant >40% we need approval from RevOps + VP Sales and a redline to add an early-conversion clause (minimum 9mo post-conversion) and limit refunds. Also require standard indemnities for private infra.

Marta (AE): Thanks. Buyer is pushing hard on procurement timeline (they want POC start in 10 business days). If we offer 30% + $25k onboarding + $3k/mo support surcharge during pilot, can we expedite?

Frank (Deal Desk): Counterproposal: approve up to 35% discount for a 9‑month minimum commit post-conversion, with $25k onboarding and $3k/mo pilot support. Require exec approval if reps want >35%. Also include clause that private deploy only after security attestation.

Marta (AE): Can you give the pricing wording I can send to the buyer?

Frank (Deal Desk): Copy/paste: "Pilot pricing: 35% off list for POC (4 nodes) billed monthly. One-time onboarding fee $25,000. Pilot support surcharge $3,000/mo. Conversion to Dedicated requires minimum 9-month committed term at then-current rate; if conversion occurs within 6 months, legacy pilot credit applies up to 50% of onboarding fee. Private deployment is contingent on successful security attestation. Approval provided by Deal Desk and RevOps."

Raj (Solutions Eng): Fine from engineering. We'll scope the pen-test and provisional deployment checklist; send me their security questionnaire.

Olivia (CISO): We'll prioritize the attestation but buyer must accept limited-data POC until attestation complete.

Marta (AE): Ok I'll send buyer Frank's wording and request exec sign-off if they push >35%. Triage: I'll post the SQ to Raj and attach legal contact Sam.

Sam (Legal): I'll prep the contract addendum template. Ping me once buyer confirms acceptance.

deploy-bot: New doc created: sales/deals/ACME-POC-2026 (private-poc-terms) :link:

Marta (AE): Thanks — will update once buyer responds. :thumbsup:
